game.notes: Every bird now has its own species calls for a new highscore, every 10 points and crashing. New deep water splash. 60 FPS limit fixed on 90/144 Hz screens. Much smoother day/night cycle: the sun glow and background are pre-rendered instead of being redrawn while the light changes.
